name: dial bot (Matt)
tagline: Makes a real phone call on your behalf and tells you how it went
description: Wires chat up to a voice-calling service, so asking it to ring a number and put a question to whoever answers actually dials. Once the call is over you get a written account of what happened. The first run collects the key and the voice it should use, and after that it simply works.
author: mattyp
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
